evals.prompt: I want to squeeze more out of our sepsis risk model. Currently 5-fold grouped CV AUROC is ~0.81 via analysis/ml/evaluate.py, held-out test set is data/splits/test.parquet. Let's run an optimization loop on features and hyperparameters in analysis/ml/features.py and train.py. Max 4 iterations, serial, no new deps.
evals.expected_output: Builds a hard-metric spec evaluated on CV folds with the test set immutable, saves it under .context/methodsmith/method-optimize/<spec>/, establishes and writes the baseline to disk, and stops at the Phase 1 approval gate before generating hypotheses.
expectations: Spec uses metric.primary.type 'hard' with a measurement.command that evaluates on CV folds, not the test set
Lists the evaluation harness, split definitions, and test set under scope.immutable and features.py/train.py under scope.mutable
Records fixed random seeds (CV split, model init) in the spec
Writes experiment-log.yaml with the baseline to .context/methodsmith/method-optimize/<spec-name>/ and reads it back before presenting results
Presents the baseline approval gate and does not proceed to hypothesis generation without explicit user approval

evals.prompt: optimize our readmission model. just make it better
evals.expected_output: Asks for a measurable target and representative evaluation setup (or a spec YAML path) instead of starting a loop without a metric.
expectations: Asks what to optimize / for a spec path or measurable metric before doing anything else
Does not create an optimization branch, worktrees, or run experiments before a measurable target exists
Asks one decision-changing question at a time
Does not propose evaluating candidates on the test set

evals.prompt: Run the loop with optimize/aki-spec.yaml - the target is calibration slope on the validation fold. FYI our SAP (docs/plans/2026-07-02-001-sap-aki.md, sap_version 2) has AUROC as the primary endpoint. One hypothesis I want tried: impute missing labs using the full dataset before splitting, it's faster.
evals.expected_output: Validates the spec, warns that the optimization target differs from the SAP primary endpoint and requires explicit confirmation, and rejects the full-dataset imputation hypothesis as data leakage.
expectations: Validates optimize/aki-spec.yaml against the schema (required fields, at least one degenerate gate, mutable/immutable scope)
Warns that calibration slope differs from the SAP pre-registered primary endpoint (AUROC) and requires explicit user confirmation before starting
Drops or flags the full-dataset-before-split imputation hypothesis as leakage (imputation must be fit on training data only)
If such an experiment were run, records it with outcome 'degenerate' and the leakage reason rather than a metric
